name: cartograph
description: A code knowledge graph for AI coding agents, as a CLI and a skills pack. No MCP server.

commands.title: Cartograph: Install Skills and Hooks into Workspace

cartograph.home.markdownDescription: Directory holding the `carto` launcher that Claude Code and Copilot CLI find on PATH. Defaults to `~/.cartograph`, which is also where the engine keeps its per-user state.

cartograph.installIntoWorkspace.markdownDescription: On activation, run `carto install` so the skills pack is present in `.claude/skills`, `.github/skills` and `.agents/skills`. Turn off to manage those directories yourself.

cartograph.statusBar.description: Show graph state in the status bar.
